text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: The NEC PC-8001 was released in 1979 and became one of Japan's earliest successful personal computers. It used a Z80 processor and supported programming through built-in BASIC. The system was expandable through peripherals and supported cassette and floppy disk storage. Its software library included business applications, educational programs, and early computer games. The PC-8001 helped establish NEC's dominance in the Japanese computer market.
